summary: Specifies conventions for how S/MIME version 3.2 agents use X.509 certificates, including validating certificates and processing the information in them. It is on the standards track and was replaced by RFC 8550.

eli5.summary: Secure email needs digital ID cards. This document says how mail programs should check and use them. It was replaced by RFC 8550.

questions: how does s/mime 3.2 use x.509 certificates
